verdicts.reason: A has no shared left edge: the quote mark sits at about x=155, the headline at about x=152 and the attribution juts out to x=75. 'Rated 5 out of 5' floats in mid-canvas, the logo hangs in empty space mid-right instead of anchoring an edge, and the attribution crowds the bottom edge. B puts the quote mark, headline and attribution on one left edge with the rating grouped beside the attribution and the logo pinned right, but it still leaves a dead ~160px band on the left, shrinks the quote mark to a speck and leaves the headline small for the strip.
